GOOGLE.PLACES.PLACE_ID.notes: Place IDs are exempt from caching restrictions. Google recommends refreshing IDs older than 12 months.

GOOGLE.PLACES.POSITION.notes: Places API latitude/longitude may be cached up to 30 consecutive calendar days. Effective local cache lifetime is shortened by the configured safety margin.

GOOGLE.PLACES.NAME.notes: Fail-closed default. Places content must not be cached/stored beyond explicit exceptions. Change only after verifying the exact API/content permission.

GOOGLE.PLACES.ADDRESS.notes: Fail-closed default for Places API content. Do not infer permissions from a different Google API such as Geocoding or Address Validation.

GOOGLE.PLACES.DETAILS.notes: Fail-closed umbrella key. Prefer field-specific keys when a verified exception exists.

NAVER.LOCAL_SEARCH.RESULT.notes: Fail closed until the exact NAVER Local Search storage/caching terms are reviewed and recorded here.

NAVER.GEOCODING.RESULT.notes: Fail closed until the exact NAVER Geocoding storage/caching terms are reviewed and recorded here.

NAVER.DIRECTIONS5.RESULT.notes: Current TripPlanner policy already keeps route geometry/metrics transient. Keep ttlHours=0 unless explicit storage permission is verified.
